description.narrative: Stöd genom UNDP till en tunisisk nationell anti-korruptionsmekanism med fokus på ökad transparens, redovisningsansvar och demokratisk samhällsstyrning.
Support through UNDP to the establishment of a national anti corruption mechanism in Tunisia focusing on transparency, accountability and democratic governanvence.

The objective of the project is to support the establishment of a National Integrity System in Tunisia through focusing on four main objectives/result areas; 1. Development of a national anti-corruption strategy and action plan. 2. Establishment of a Tunisian Anti-Corruption Agency. 3. Development of diagnostic reports on the existing anti-corruption legal frames. 4. Institutionalization of knowledge about anti-corruption, transparency and accountability. 5. Increase of public awareness of anti-corruption, transparency and accountability.

Overall the main objectives/targets under each of the five results area are to a large degree achieved. A national anti-corruption strategy and action plan has been developed, the Tunisian Anti-Corruption Agency (INLUCC) has been established. Although it wasn't until the very end of the project that INLUCC got the resources and staff necessary to handle its assignment it now seems to be well set up, legally, structurally as well as staff wise, to take on the role attributed to it. The project helped assess the legal landscape of anti-corruption related laws and regulations and contributed to the formulation and putting in place of 3 new laws related to transparency and accountability. The project contributed to the raising of staff capacity through trainings and by facilitating the building of partnerships, and it also helped increase the public awareness on anti-corruption, transparency and accountability through training of journalists and public campaigns.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
